SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF AUG-31-2016 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF AUG-31-2016 BY JUDGE PRO TEM DAVID LAVINE. APPEARANCE BY PLAINTIFF, ONLY. NO COSTS AWARDED BY COURT. PLAINTIFFS EXHIBITS RETAINED. DEFENDANTS EXHIBITS NOT RETAINED. JUDGE PRO TEM: DAVID LAVINE. CLERK: P. NATT. NOT REPORTED. (506)
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF AUG-31-2016 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF CHAN, TRACY IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT WELLS FARGO BANK "EVEN IF THE COST, CREDITS PLAINTIFF'S EVIDENCE IN SUPPORT OF LIABILITY FOR DEFENDANT'S FAILURE TO HONOR ON APPROVE LOAN, DEFENDANT DID NOT SUFFICIENTLY ESTABLISH HER DAMAMGES, WHICH APPEAR SPECULATIVE TO THE COURT. DEFENDANT DID NOT APPEAR", PER PRO TEM JUDGE DAVID LAVINE. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS PLAINTIFF'S EXHIBITS RECEIVED
